title: G4 Delta Run
style: Drift phonk and cinematic cyberpunk at 144 BPM with pounding 808s, swung cowbell slides, acid lead hooks, and siren FX. Intro hits with filtered engine rumble; verses stay bare and tense; pre-chorus stacks chanting doubles; chorus opens wide with melodic sung hooks and gang shouts. Tire-screech transitions, reverse swells, and hard sidechain give a bright, brutal, blockbuster mix with male rap leads and soaring hook doubles., stylized, natural, strong, world, steady, theme, rap, soundtrack, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
G4 data break breach now run, run, run!
Go go go!
Safe and sound
Sirens, agent chatter
808
Safe and Sound
Unit 48 — all good

[Verse 1]
Acid adrenalin pumping
Heart bass drum stomping
Conductor mind
Next move to find
Guard got up
Spin and drop
Roll upside down
Without a frown
As that clown
Will take you down
Driver ready
Hands steady
Mirror eyes
Here’s my guys
Zyn Maths Driver
Faster smarter

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
G4 data break breach now run
Hit the street
Like it was all last week
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
I heard a siren cry

[Verse 2]
Watch out, Pig Truck!
Driver drifts then push
No bacon tonight
Pigs safe and sound
Big black hearse truck
Means only one thing
Rest in peace
No releases
Sirens blare
Drive no care
Cops are here
Pigs, I care

[Bridge]
Driver spins
No pig skin
Big black truck
Driver takes the tyre out
Pigs freed
Safe and sound
Cops on the back
Driver stop!
The driver drifts
Sneaky sneaky
Shades the move
Pork little piggies almost got smacked
On the G4 delta track

[Verse 3]
Bumble Bee bytes breached and streaming right
Elephant mind never forgets the code in the night
CoreyAI eyes seeing every vector and degree
Super intelligence on the G4 data break breach
Zyn Maths Driver faster smarter, doing the maths in real time
360 spin rewriting probability lines
Reverse reverse reverse, bending simulation design
3 mirrors showing every possible breach path aligned
Maths Driver calculated with elephant precision
Viral stunts, data exfil complete, no collision
Job break successful, the equation is clean
Zyn Maths Driver has us, safe and sound

[Chorus]
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
G4 data break breach now run
Hit the street
Like it was all last week
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Drive, driver, drive!
I heard a siren cry

[Outro]
Driver got us home
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
Safe and sound
